brief: Maths Standard start (root request, 19 November 2026), methods of brief 243
purpose: Research route inputs for Claude, not a canonical route or teaching approval
syllabus: Mathematics Standard 11-12 (2024), Year 12 Standard 2 (no matching Standard 1 points)
identifierPolicy: Exact CMS codenames; official sourceHtml preserves mathematical layout. Year 12 entries list Standard 2 and Standard 1 codenames separately (standard2ActionIds, standard1ActionIds); these three focus areas have no Standard 1 points, so standard1ActionIds is empty.

officialEvidence.source: NSW Curriculum Year 12 Standard 2 The normal distribution, Critical path analysis and Network flow pages, as recorded in the crosswalk (read 18 November 2026)

siteSource.note: Paths are repo paths at this commit, read from the read-only local clone C:/Users/kygs/teaching-app-fix at the same commit (not modified). SHA256 values recomputed from the clone on 19 November 2026 and match the crosswalk inventory. All fourteen lessons use data-step-id sections. Normal distribution lessons 06 and 07 label worked examples we-1 (06 also we-2), lessons 03 and 05 we-1, lesson08 we-1 and we-2; critical path lesson01 labels we-l07-1 to we-l07-3 and lessons 02 to 06 have no example ids; network flow lessons label we-1 to we-3. The normal distribution folder has lessons 03 and 05 to 08 only.

recommendations: Run z01 to z06, then c01 to c06, then f01 to f04 after Relative frequency and probability (outline recommended order; root ruling 28). All sixteen are Standard 2 only: the 2024 Standard 1 course has no normal distribution, critical path analysis or network flow focus area, so Standard 1 viewers finish the Year 12 course at math-s12-p08 and these videos carry no Standard 1 codes.
Playlist order: the outline's numbers 77 to 92 stand (rulings 46 and 58 moved only r and t); split parts would share their number.

Joins: z01 opens on p08's final frame; z01's pack proposed a two-route frame (Standard 2: the bakery's loaf histogram; Standard 1: course complete, see the playlist) and the p08 pack accepts it; the bakery plate is briefed once, in z01's asset brief. z06 ends on the bakery-cafe's morning jobs (c01's anchor); c06 ends on the stadium walkways (f01's anchor); f04 ends the course with a playlist pointer and no promises of future videos.

Advanced reuse (ruling 7): the Year 12 Advanced normal kit (NormalCurve, BandSlider, ZSlider, TailLadder, SigmaRuler, ScoreCompare; ClassHistogram) covers z01 to z06 with a 'rule readout' mode added (68, 95, 99.7 and the pieces, not table values); the Advanced anchors (chips, apples, fish, the bottle filler) and scripts are not reused. The Standard course uses no density formula and no normal table: probabilities come from whole-number z-scores and the empirical rule only.

Networks have no existing kit. checks/maths-standard-kit-needs-z-c-f.md describes a shared ProjectModel with ActivityNetwork, ScanSweep, PathStack, FloatTable, GanttChart and ProjectSheet for critical paths, and FlowModel with FlowNetwork, CutLine and DemandGauge for flow; both course-neutral and sharing one graph layout.

Pace flags (gentler Standard pace): c01 at risk (suggested split c01a and c01b); z04, z05, c02, c03, c05 and f01 to watch (suggested splits for z05 and f01 only if a design runs past 570 s); z01, z02, z03, z06, c04, c06, f02, f03 and f04 fit 6 to 8 minutes.

Site findings: MS-47 to MS-59 appended to docs/production/claude-pm/site-corrections-maths-standard.md, section 9 (a wrong memory trick and a misstated total, an impossible sleep regression, a hero caption of 12 against arrows that give 7, a crossed-out worked attempt and a missing question, a seven-activity example needing two dummies, wrong days in a scheduling example, node slack called float, a path-order claim contradicted on its own page, a miscounted title, owner notes on methods beyond Standard 2, an unsourced height hook, old module labels and 2017 codes, and three points stated but not shown).

Outline problems: none in the point assignment (all 26 points of the three focus areas are owned once). The outline's z-strand Advanced reuse candidates are math-a12-s09 to s11; math-a12-s12 (the filling machine) also has reusable motion, noted in z05 and z06. The outline lists the CPA spreadsheet (c06) under lesson03 only, which is right; lesson06 (module review) is used only for one delay example in c05.
covers: math-s12-z01 to z06 (The normal distribution), math-s12-c01 to c06 (Critical path analysis) and math-s12-f01 to f04 (Network flow), Year 12 Standard 2
